title: unit.v1
description: One software unit of a component's detailed design (SWE.3 BP1). Stored as a fenced ```yaml unit block in <component-id>.md under qf.yaml paths.detailed_design_dir, one file per component; this schema validates one block. That the file is named after an architecture component, that every unit comes from a node of that component's design diagram and every node is a unit, and that calls name units of the same component are gate rules of check_detailed_design_contract_gate.

id.description: The unit's ID — the ID of the design-diagram node it comes from, unique in the product. Code and tests name it as @unit[<id>].

derived_from.description: The node of the component's design diagram <component-id>.architecture.json, as <component-id>#<node>. The design diagram is drawn at stage 4 and agreed at the pull request, not at a checkpoint.

responsibility.description: What it is responsible for, in one sentence.

inputs.description: What the unit receives. Empty when it takes nothing.

outputs.description: What the unit returns or emits. Empty when it produces nothing.

calls.description: SWE.3 BP1 relationships: the units of the same component this unit depends on and calls.

port.description: One input or output. A numeric one has a valid range and a unit of measure; any other declares both as not applicable.

type.description: The type in the product's language, e.g. number, int, string, Session.

range.description: The valid range, both ends inclusive, or 'not applicable' for a value that is not numeric.

unit.description: The unit of measure, e.g. °C, ms, count; 'not applicable' exactly when the range is.
